name: RISE Teen Program
org: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry (MSI Chicago)
what_you_do: A free program where teens explore careers in science, tech, engineering, arts and math. You do hands-on projects, LEGO engineering challenges and panels with pros and mentors. You can join a 12-week session or drop in.
who_can_apply: Teens. The page does not list an age or grade rule.
pay_detail: Free. Participants get free museum admission, free parking, and volunteer hours on request.
duration: Fall 2026 session: 12 Saturdays, Oct 3, 2026 to Jan 9, 2027, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: Registration for the Fall 2026 session has closed. Next session dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Details and registration links on the RISE page. Questions: Contact Us form on the page.
notes: The museum website is now griffinmsi.org. The regular museum volunteer program is for adults 18 and over, so RISE is the teen route. The structured 12-week session may lead to internships, the page says. Also offers a drop-in option with no long commitment.
